title: Prayer, the Beelzebul Controversy, and Woes

questions.question: When Jesus was praying in a certain place, one of His disciples asked Him to teach them to pray, just as who taught his disciples?
questions.explanation: Luke 11:1 (ESV): "Now Jesus was praying in a certain place, and when he finished, one of his disciples said to him, 'Lord, teach us to pray, as John taught his disciples.'"

questions.question: In the version of the Lord's Prayer in Luke 11, what phrase follows: "give us each day..."?
questions.explanation: Luke 11:3 (ESV): "Give us each day our daily bread,"

questions.question: In the parable on prayer about a friend arriving at midnight, what does the host ask his neighboring friend to lend him?
questions.explanation: Luke 11:5 (ESV): "And he said to them, 'Which of you who has a friend will go to him at midnight and say to him, "Friend, lend me three loaves..."'"

questions.question: Why does Jesus say the friend in bed will eventually get up and give his neighbor whatever he needs?
options: Because he is a good and righteous man
Because he is afraid of the noise waking his children
Because the neighbor promises to pay double tomorrow
questions.explanation: Luke 11:8 (ESV): "I tell you, though he will not get up and give him anything because he is his friend, yet because of his impudence he will rise and give him whatever he needs."

questions.question: Jesus promises: "And I tell you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find..." and what else?
options: "...knock, and it will be opened to you."
"...trust, and angels will minister to you."
questions.correctAnswer: "...knock, and it will be opened to you."
questions.explanation: Luke 11:9 (ESV): "And I tell you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you."

questions.question: What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will instead give him a what?
questions.explanation: Luke 11:11 (ESV): "What father among you, if his son asks for a fish, will instead of a fish give him a serpent;"

questions.question: Jesus teaches that if human fathers know how to give good gifts, how much more will the heavenly Father give what to those who ask him?
questions.explanation: Luke 11:13 (ESV): "If you then, who are evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will the heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him!"

questions.question: When Jesus was casting out a demon that was mute, some of the people accused Him of casting out demons by the power of whom?
questions.explanation: Luke 11:15 (ESV): "But some of them said, 'He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of demons.'"

questions.question: How did Jesus logically refute their accusation?
options: "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and a divided household falls."
"The prince of demons cannot enter the synagogue."
"I pray to the Father, and he casts them out."
"Beelzebul is chained in the abyss for a thousand years."
questions.correctAnswer: "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and a divided household falls."
questions.explanation: Luke 11:17 (ESV): "Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and a divided household falls."

questions.question: What happens when an unclean spirit leaves a person, finds no rest, and decides to return to its house?
options: It brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and the last state of that person is worse than the first
It is blocked by angels guarding the door
It stays a short while and leaves forever
The person dies in their sleep
questions.correctAnswer: It brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and the last state of that person is worse than the first
questions.explanation: Luke 11:26 (ESV): "Then it goes and brings seven other spirits more evil than itself, and they enter and dwell there. And the last state of that person is worse than the first."

questions.question: When a woman in the crowd raised her voice and blessed the womb that bore Him, what did Jesus say is an even greater blessing?
options: "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it!"
"Blessed is the Mother of the Lord forever."
"Blessed are all the daughters of Abraham."
questions.correctAnswer: "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it!"
questions.explanation: Luke 11:28 (ESV): "But he said, 'Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it!'"

questions.question: When the crowds were increasing, Jesus said "This generation is an evil generation. It seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except..."?
options: The sign of the Son of Man in heaven
questions.explanation: Luke 11:29 (ESV): "This generation is an evil generation. It seeks for a sign, but no sign will be given to it except the sign of Jonah."

questions.question: During dinner, why was the Pharisee astonished at Jesus?
options: Because he did not first wash before dinner
Because he ate massive amounts of meat
Because he invited a tax collector inside
Because he refused to pray aloud
questions.correctAnswer: Because he did not first wash before dinner
questions.explanation: Luke 11:38 (ESV): "The Pharisee was astonished to see that he did not first wash before dinner."

questions.question: What "woe" did Jesus speak against the Pharisees regarding their tithing practices?
options: "For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and neglect justice and the love of God."
"For you tithe sheep, but neglect the poor orphans at your gate."
"For you steal from the offering to build larger houses."
"For you only tithe when others are watching you."
questions.correctAnswer: "For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and neglect justice and the love of God."
questions.explanation: Luke 11:42 (ESV): "But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, and neglect justice and the love of God."

questions.question: Jesus pronounced another "woe" on the lawyers because they have taken away the key of what?
questions.explanation: Luke 11:52 (ESV): "Woe to you lawyers! For you have taken away the key of knowledge. You did not enter yourselves, and you hindered those who were entering."

key_verse_text: "And I tell you, ask, and it will be given to you; seek, and you will find; knock, and it will be opened to you."
